machine_extruder_start_code.default_value:
;;;;;;;;;;;;;;
;START Tool 1 Custom Pre-Script
M83; Extuder Relative
M900 K{material_linear_advance_factor}; K comp
M420 L1; Topo comp enable for T1
M109 S{material_print_temperature} T1; T1 to Temp
M106 S{cool_fan_speed_max};Part fan on
G12 T1 ; Wiping idle purge
G27 S0 T1; Park to avoid blade
G27 S1 T1; Park position to purge
G1 E5 F300 ; unretract
;M104 S{material_print_temperature} T1; T1 to Temp
;M106 S{cool_fan_speed_min}; Fan On
G12 T1; Wiping
G27 S0 T1; Park to avoid blade
G27 S1 T1; Park position to purge
G12 T1; Wiping
M83; Extuder Relative
;END Tool 1 Custom Pre-Script
;;;;;;;;;;;;;;

machine_extruder_end_code.default_value:
;;;;;;;;;;;;;;
;START Tool 1 Custom Post-Script
M83; Extuder Relative
G1 E-{retraction_amount} F3000 ;Retract
M104 S{material_standby_temperature} T1; Setting idle temp
G27 P0 S0 T1; Park to avoid blade
G27 P0 S1 T1; Park position to purge
M106 S{material_surface_energy} ; Purging Fan Speed
; 'material_surface_energy' variable is being used as a stand-in variable for fan speed while purging
G1 E{material_flush_purge_length} F{material_flush_purge_speed} ; Purge T1
G4 S5; Wait before wiping for nozzle to cool and have less ooze after wipe
G12 T1; Wiping idle purge
G27 S0 T1; Park to avoid blade
G27 S1 T1; Park position to purge
G1 E-5 S F180 ; Retract to help ooze from swap
M83; Extuder Relative
;END Tool 1 Custom Post-Script
;;;;;;;;;;;;;;
